a.lede: Google confirmed ChromeOS updates will phase out in 2034 as the company transitions to Googlebook OS and new laptops.
a.title: Google confirms ChromeOS phase out in 2034 — 10-year support lifetime cut short for some devices, company says it will support transition to Googlebook OS

b.lede: Some recent Chromebook devices will be able to switch to the new operating system.
b.title: Google will support ChromeOS until 2034 as it shifts to Googlebook OS
